# A bill's grouped payment naming two splits parked in CAD.
#
# The bill side of the shape a payment naming several splits cannot divide.
# Each `Assets:Due From Director` split carries a CAD figure that stood in for
# the payable — 41.70 and 41.70 of the 83.40 the entry is quoted at — and
# neither is a fact about the settlement.
#
# One such split can be restated from what the bank sent. Two cannot: dividing
# the 60.00 USD between them needs a ratio, and the only numbers on offer are
# the ones being discarded.
#
# The refusal explains that a parked split's figure "stood in for the ..." —
# and for a bill that is the **payable**.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming both splits and the payable,
# with the entry untouched.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-USD-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Parts"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-04-02
    amount: 60
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    Transaction "5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c"
      PaymentSplit "7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c5f6a"
      PaymentSplit "8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c5f6a7b"
